question: Aman has taken a loan of ₹50,000 from a bank at the rate of 8% to be compounded annually. How much does he have to pay after 3 years? (Nearest to a ₹)
solution:
Given:

Principal = ₹50,000

Time = 3 years

Rate of interest = 8% per annum

Interest is compounded yearly.

Concept used:

In the case of compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Now, the compound interest on ₹8,500 in 2 years at 8% per annum

⇒ 50000(1 + {{8} over 100}){3} 

⇒ 50000(1.08){3} 

⇒ 62985.6 ≈ ₹62986

∴ The Amount paid after 3 years is **₹6****2,986**.
